Issue #230 visual proof

The before images are the retained issue #226 native surfaces, copied
verbatim. They show colour-only rugs and thin line swatches that are
difficult to read at reduced size and under colour-vision deficiency.

The after images are generated from the current plotting functions using
a fixed synthetic fixture. Categorical metadata retains colour and adds
baseline stem line type and height when critical-point overlays are hidden;
the critical-point view uses stem width and height because shape is reserved
for critical-point classes. Continuous metadata retains colour and adds
baseline stem height and width. Decomposition points use colour plus shape or
size in one layer. Categorical encodings reject more than eight observed
levels rather than assigning ambiguous marks. Native 100 x 80 mm and reduced-height
100 x 64 mm renders (80 mm high for the decomposition surfaces), plus
deuteranopia-simulated native and reduced-height outputs are retained
for inspection.

Captions are generated by scientific_caption() and retained in
captions.txt. Regenerate with: Rscript scripts/render-issue-230-proof.R
